'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Gaza City]]
***[[Al-Shifa Hospital siege]]
****[[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]'s two largest hospitals, [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] and [[Al-Quds Hospital]], both suspend operations. [https://www.npr.org/2023/11/12/1212529494/international-outcry-grows-over-unbearably-desperate-situation-in-gaza-hospitals (NPR)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/13/gazas-two-biggest-hospitals-cease-operations-as-who-warns-of-rising-deaths (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] of the [[Golani Brigade]] seize control of the [[Palestinian Legislative Council]] building in [[Gaza City]], which has been used by [[Hamas]] lawmakers since 2007. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-troops-inside-gazas-parliament-building-with-israeli-flags/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***Israel bombs the Al-Salam Mosque in [[Sabra, Gaza|Sabra]], increasing the total number of mosques destroyed by Israeli forces to more than 60. [https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1788942 (Dawn)]
**[[United Nations]] compounds around the world lower the [[UN flag]] to [[half-mast]] to honour the 101 UN workers who have been killed by Israeli attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/un-observes-minutes-silence-101-staff-killed-gaza-2023-11-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/13/gazas-two-biggest-hospitals-cease-operations-as-who-warns-of-rising-deaths (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[UNRWA|UN agency for Palestinian refugees]] says that the [[Israeli Navy]] damaged one of its [[guesthouse]]s in [[Rafah]], despite having shared [[coordinates]] with Israel multiple times. [https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/unrwa-guesthouse-southern-gaza-receives-three-direct-hits-israeli-forces-naval-bombardment (Relief Web)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/13/gazas-two-biggest-hospitals-cease-operations-as-who-warns-of-rising-deaths (Al Jazeera)]
**Director of the UN agency for [[Palestinian refugees]] [[Thomas White]] says that [[humanitarian]] operations in Gaza will be suspended within the next 48 hours due to a shortage of fuel. [https://www.barrons.com/news/un-warns-fuel-shortage-to-halt-gaza-aid-work-in-48-hours-4d8af669 (AFP via Barron's)]
**[[World Health Organization]] Director-General [[Tedros Adhanom]]s warns of a "dire and perilous" situation in Gaza's hospitals, saying that more patients, including premature babies, are dying. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/gaza-hospitals-dire-situation-some-stop-operations/story?id=104843083 (ABC News)]
**The [[Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics]] says that 3,117 students enrolled in schools in Gaza have been killed by Israel, while 4,613 have been injured. A further 130 teachers and [[school administrator]]s are also killed. Twenty-four students have been killed in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/13/israel-hamas-war-live-gazas-two-largest-hospitals-shut-amid-nonstop-raids (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Chin National Army]] says that they captured a [[Tatmadaw]] base in [[Rikhawdar]], [[Chin State]], and are currently fighting for control of the town which is located on the [[India–Myanmar border|border with]] [[India]]. More than 5,000 people flee across the border into India's [[Mizoram]] state. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-under-attack-new-front-opposition-intensifies-2023-11-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/chin-resistance-routs-myanmar-junta-in-second-indian-border-town.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
***Fighting occurs between the military and the [[Arakan Army]] in several townships in [[Rakhine State]], with the Arakan Army claiming that it took several outposts. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/myanmar-junta-outposts-fall-in-northern-rakhine-arakan-army.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***[[Arakan Army]] launched an attack at [[Paletwa]] town in [[Chin State]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/arakan-army-declares-victory-in-paletwa-myanmars-chin-state.html (Irrawaddy)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Russian Air Force|Russian]] airstrikes on rebel-held [[Idlib Governorate]] kill at least 34 fighters and injure more than 60 others, according to the [[Russian Reconciliation Center for Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/russian-forces-kill-34-fighters-syrias-idlib-interfax-agency-2023-11-13/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Scottish First Minister]] [[Humza Yousaf]] reiterates his call for an "immediate [[ceasefire]]" in the war on [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], saying that "children in Gaza don't need a pause in the killing, they need it to stop". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/13/israel-hamas-war-live-gazas-two-largest-hospitals-shut-amid-nonstop-raids (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Amnesty International]] says that [[EU]] countries "must" call for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, adding that "the expanding humanitarian and [[human rights violations|human rights catastrophe]] unfolding in Gaza urgently needs to end". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/13/israel-hamas-war-live-gazas-two-largest-hospitals-shut-amid-nonstop-raids (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[Antisemitism during the 2023 Israel–Hamas war]]
***Over 182,000 demonstrators march in cities across [[France]], protesting the surge in [[Antisemitism|antisemitic]] incidents since the outbreak of the war. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/11/13/europe/france-march-antisemitism-israel-hamas-war-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Code of Conduct for Justices of the Supreme Court of the United States]]
**For the first time in its history, the [[United States Supreme Court]] issues a [[code of conduct]] to govern its justices. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/supreme-court/supreme-court-code-of-conduct-rcna124951 (NBC)]
*[[LGBT rights in Austria]]
**[[Ministry of Justice (Austria)|Justice Minister]] [[Alma Zadić]] announces the allocation of {{Euro|33 million|link=yes}} (around [[United States dollar|US$]]35 million) to [[Financial compensation|compensate]] approximately 11,000 [[LGBT]] people affected by [[History of Austria|the country's historical]] [[Discrimination against LGBT people|discriminatory]] laws. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/11/14/23/austria-to-compensate-gay-people-convicted-under-discriminatory-laws (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*[[Philippine drug war]]
**A [[Regional Trial Court]] grants [[bail]] to [[Protests against Rodrigo Duterte|opposition]] leader and former [[Senator of the Philippines|Senator]] [[Leila de Lima]] on her last drug case, ending her six years in detention. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/13/asia/philippines-leila-de-lima-drug-charges-bail-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Polish parliamentary election]]
**[[Poland 2050]] leader [[Szymon Hołownia]] is elected as [[Marshal of the Sejm]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/11/13/polish-pro-eu-candidate-elected-speaker-of-parliament_6252189_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[November 2023 British cabinet reshuffle]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] [[dismissal (employment)|dismisses]] [[Suella Braverman]] as [[Home Secretary]] after Braverman condemned a pro-Palestinian protest in [[central London]], replacing her with [[Foreign Secretary (United Kingdom)|Foreign Secretary]] [[James Cleverly]] and appointing former Prime Minister [[David Cameron]] as the new Foreign Secretary. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/uk-ex-pm-david-cameron-gets-cabinet-role-in-big-political-comeback-4570378 (AFP via NDTV)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/13/uk/suella-braverman-leaves-government-rishi-sunak-gbr-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]]
**[[Nepal]] bans [[TikTok]], citing misuse of the app that "disturbs social harmony and disrupts family structures and social relations". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/13/nepal-to-ban-tiktok-as-it-disturbs-social-harmony (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Korean Series]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[LG Twins]] defeat the [[KT Wiz]] to win the [[Korean Series]] in five games, capturing their third championship and their first since 1994. [https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20231113000799 (''The Korea Herald'')]
